title: The Queen Can Wait
setup: White's queen has just captured yours on b6. Taking back is the obvious move, and it is not the best one.
hint: Your recapture can wait one move, as long as the move before it is a check.
explanation:
## The Idea

{{axb6}} at once is an even trade, and then White simply moves the bishop on e2 away from your knight. So check first. {{Nxe2+}} takes the bishop, and {{Kh1}} is White's only legal move. The queen on b6 is still standing there, and {{axb6}} collects it. You took back one move late and a whole bishop richer.
